readme.excerpt: # Dex **Analytics engineering for your coding agent, with guardrails and lifecycle built into the engine.** Dex lets your agent build your analytics: data warehouse exploration, dbt data transformation and semantic modeling, and schema-drift maintenance. **Built by [Exmergo](https://www.exmergo.com)** [![PyPI](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/exmergo-dex-core?logo=pypi&logoColor=white&color=165dfc)](https://pypi.org/project/exmergo-dex-core/) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-165dfc)](LICENSE) [![data-eng-bench](https://img.shields.io/badge/data--eng--bench-57%25-33cf56)](benchmarks/data-eng-bench/README.md) [![ADE-bench](https://img.shields.io/badge/ADE--bench-76%25-33cf56)](benchmarks/ade_bench/README.md) [![CI](https://github.com/exmergo/dex/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/exmergo/dex/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-docs.exmergo.com%2Fdex-165dfc?logo=readthedocs&logoColor=white)](https://docs.exmergo.com/dex) [![LinkedIn](https://img.shields.io/badge/LinkedIn-Exmergo-165dfc?logo=linkedin&logoColor=white)](https://www.linkedin.com/company/exmergo/) [![X](https://img.shields.io/badge/Follow-%40exmergo-165dfc?logo=x&logoColor=white)](https://x.com/exmergo) [![Star the repo!](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/exmergo/dex?style=flat&label=Star%20the%20repo!%20%E2%AD%90&labelColor=555&logo=github&logoColor=white&color=165dfc)](https://github.com/exmergo/dex) ## Install **Any agent** (run in your terminal): ```bash npx skills add exmergo/dex ``` **Claude Code** (run these inside Claude Code, one at a time): ``` /plugin marketplace add exmergo/exmergo-agent-plugins ``` ``` /plugin install dex@exmergo ``` **Codex**: ```bash npx skills add exmergo/dex --agent codex ``` > [!IMPORTANT] > **Dex needs [`uv`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) on your `PATH`.** No agent installs > it for you. Run `brew install uv` or `pipx install uv`, or see the > [uv installation docs](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/) > for other platforms. `uv` supplies Python and the engine. Use uv 0.13.4 or > later (`uv self update`): earlier releases still trust the emSign CA roots > withdrawn after their keys were compromised. In Claude Code the skills appear as `/dex:explore`, `/dex:transform`, and `/dex:maintain` and trigger on matching intent. Update later with `/plugin marketplace update exmergo`. Codex also gets a native plugin, with no MCP server needed. Any other agent can be pointed at [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md). Run Dex from your project directory, so it finds your `.dex/config.yml` and keeps its cache next to your project. Dex needs an agent with a local shell, so it does not run in claude.ai chat. > [!TIP] > **Skip the first-run wait.** The first command installs the engine, which takes > tens of seconds on a cold `uv` cache. Ask your agent to warm Dex once after > installing, or run the command below in a CI or container build step. Add > `--connector snowflake` (or any connector) to warm one before a project exists. ```bash uv run --no-project --script skills//scripts/run.py --warm ``` What you get: - **Explore** a warehouse you have never seen. Ranked inventory, column profiles built from aggregates, PII flags, verified joins, and an ER diagram. - **Transform** your dbt project and semantic layer. Models, tests, docs, and metrics arrive as reviewable plans and build only on a dev target. - **Maintain** it as the world changes. Schema, volume, grain, and metric-definition drift, each with a proposed fix. Your source data is never written to, and builds run on a dev target only. Cost quoted before any spend. Every change is a diff you review. Works in Claude Code, Codex, or any agent that loads Ag
